changes: Adventure now starts with a wooden shovel instead of a stone axe; the axe is combined from sticks, rock shards and grass fibre
New stone shovel: 2 sticks, 2 rock shards and 2 grass fibre; it digs faster than the wooden shovel, which you can now make from 4 sticks and 2 grass fibre
Sand breaks into sand clumps, and 8 make sand again
Whatever rests on a block drops when the block goes, however it goes: tall grass, torches, saplings and the rocks and sticks lying on it no longer vanish or float
Cutting tall grass always gives a grass fibre, and a seed about half the time
Dropped grass fibre lies as a little bundle of blades, and gems as small crystals, instead of tiny blocks
